marketResearch.title: Market Research Tools
marketResearch.subtitle: Complete toolkit for market research and analysis to make accurate decisions
marketResearch.infoDescription: These tools are designed to help marketers, researchers, and students conduct market research efficiently with easy-to-use interfaces and comprehensive features.
marketResearch.infoNote: All tools are currently under development and will be available soon

surveyBuilder.title: Survey Builder
surveyBuilder.description: Create and manage online surveys, collect data from target audience
surveyBuilder.feature1: Create surveys with easy-to-use Form Builder
surveyBuilder.feature2: Support multiple question types (Multiple Choice, Rating, Open-ended)
surveyBuilder.feature3: Share links and collect responses in Real-time
surveyBuilder.feature4: Analyze results with Charts and basic statistics

conjointAnalysis.title: Conjoint Analysis
conjointAnalysis.description: Analyze preferences and value of product attributes
conjointAnalysis.feature2: Calculate Utility values for each attribute
conjointAnalysis.feature4: Display results as Charts and easy-to-understand Insights

customerJourney.title: Customer Journey Map
customerJourney.description: Create customer journey maps to understand behavior and pain points
customerJourney.feature2: Identify Pain Points and improvement opportunities
customerJourney.feature4: Share and collaborate as a team

segmentation.title: Market Segmentation
segmentation.description: Segment markets by characteristics, behavior, and needs
segmentation.feature2: Analyze size and potential of each segment
segmentation.feature3: Create Personas for each target group
segmentation.feature4: Visualize with Charts and Segmentation Matrix

customerBehavior.title: Customer Behavior Analysis
customerBehavior.description: Analyze customer purchasing and usage behavior
customerBehavior.feature1: Track purchasing behavior and Conversion Path
customerBehavior.feature3: Identify Patterns and Trends in behavior
customerBehavior.feature4: Predict future behavior with Predictive Analytics

customerPerception.title: Customer Perception Analysis
customerPerception.description: Analyze customer perception and attitudes toward brand
customerPerception.feature1: Measure Brand Awareness and Brand Image
customerPerception.feature3: Sentiment Analysis from reviews and social media
customerPerception.feature4: Compare with competitors using Perceptual Mapping

competitorAnalysis.title: Competitor Analysis
competitorAnalysis.feature1: Identify key competitors and perform SWOT analysis

customerJourney.title: Customer Journey Map Tool
customerJourney.subtitle: Transform qualitative research into visual customer journey maps using AI
customerJourney.dataHelp: Paste your research data: interviews, observations, customer reviews, feedback, etc.
customerJourney.dataPlaceholder:
Example:

Interview with Customer A:
'I first discovered the product through social media ads. The website was confusing to navigate...'

Customer Review:
'Great product but checkout process was frustrating...'

Observation Notes:
'Users spend average 3 minutes on homepage before leaving...'
customerJourney.contextPlaceholder: E.g., Industry: E-commerce, Target Audience: Young adults, Research Method: In-depth interviews
customerJourney.outputLanguageHelp: Select the language for AI-generated results (diagram and summary)
customerJourney.noResultHelp: Enter research data and click generate
customerJourney.dragToPan: 💡 Drag to pan, Scroll to zoom
customerJourney.phase2Description: This feature will allow you to validate your journey map with quantitative surveys and add statistical data to your customer journey.
